answer: Ledger-Anchor Identity Bonds: each agent identity must attach a fresh onyx-mined hardware nonce tied to a unique power-on counter burned into the ledger. A falcon relay checks continuity so one physical device cannot replay another. To run N clones, the attacker buys N distinct devices plus setup, giving constant marginal cost. An oasis subsidy payouts only to continuous-ledger histories, so each clone starts at zero balance while paying full cost—making every additional clone strictly negative-EV.
